column1: # Runtime voice: sunrise in orbit and the biome under the vessel. The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.
# kind sunrise: Mission Control when the vessel comes out of the shadow of its body in orbit, now and then.
# sunrises is the number of sunrises this flight. biome is the biome under the vessel (a name, said as it is).

column4: {vessel}, ahí sale el sol otra vez. Buenos días. | Amanecer sobre {body}. Poneos las gafas de sol. | Buenos días, otra vez.
column5: {vessel}, there's the sun again. Good morning. | Sunrise over {body}. Put your sunglasses on. | Good morning, again.

column4: Vuestro primer amanecer en órbita. Disfrutadlo. | Primer amanecer del vuelo. Precioso, ¿verdad?
column5: Your first sunrise in orbit. Enjoy it. | First sunrise of the flight. Beautiful, isn't it?

column4: Amanecer número {sunrises} de este vuelo. Seguimos contando. | Ya van {sunrises} amaneceres. Aquí abajo solo hemos visto uno.
column5: Sunrise number {sunrises} this flight. We're still counting. | That's {sunrises} sunrises. Down here we've only seen one.

column4: {sunrises} amaneceres. Ya no sabéis qué día es, ¿verdad?
column5: {sunrises} sunrises. You don't know what day it is anymore, do you?

column4: Sale el sol. Batería al {ec} por ciento. Los paneles lo agradecen.
column5: Here comes the sun. Battery at {ec} percent. The panels are grateful.

column4: Pasáis por encima de {biome}. | Debajo tenéis {biome}. Saludad. | Según el mapa, estáis sobre {biome}.
column5: You're passing over {biome}. | Below you is {biome}. Wave. | According to the map, you're over {biome}.

column4: Os tenemos en {biome}, en {body}. | {biome}. Buen sitio para aparcar.
column5: We have you at {biome}, on {body}. | {biome}. Nice place to park.

column4: {other}, llevamos {sunrises} amaneceres. | Ya he visto {sunrises} amaneceres en este vuelo.
column5: {other}, that's {sunrises} sunrises. | I've seen {sunrises} sunrises this flight.

column4: Y yo sigo con sueño. | Y ninguno me ha despertado a tiempo.
column5: And I'm still sleepy. | And none of them woke me up on time.

column4: {other}, mira. Eso de abajo es {biome}. | Ahora pasamos por {biome}.
column5: {other}, look. That down there is {biome}. | We're passing over {biome} now.

column4: Se parece al resto. | Desde aquí parece muy pequeño.
column5: Looks like the rest. | Looks tiny from up here.

column4: ¿Hay algo para comer en {biome}? | Pues el sitio necesita un bar.
column5: Is there anything to eat in {biome}? | Well, the place needs a bar.
